Russia has made the world more dangerous for America and our allies. Lindsey understood that and his determination to weaken Putin never wavered. Today’s Senate vote holds Russia and its war enablers, including Iran, accountable. 

It’s a win for our national security and a testament to his legacy.

Since March, the Iranian regime has executed 56 people—many publicly hanged for the “crime” of protesting their government.

A regime willing to treat its own people so barbarically cannot be trusted to ever stop threatening the same terror toward the outside world.

Iran will never follow through on ending nuclear production nor giving up its new found leverage in the Strait of Hormuz. They are attempting to play us….again. The only way to stop them is to eliminate their avenues of funding. Period.
Iran doesn't need missiles to threaten us, they will bring this fight to American soil however they can. Cyber attacks are just one of the weapons they will use.

China isn’t just buying Iranian oil— it’s re-arming the regime. 

We need to enforce the sanctions against China now.
Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin cannot be trusted. We can't be naive to the fact they are aiding the Iranian regime.
Iran is a threat to the entire free world, not just America. It’s in our allies' best interest to accept that and help us.
It is important to remember that yes, Iran struck our military bases and killed and injured many soldiers but who is giving them the satellite imagery to do so? China and Russia.

Every dollar the Iranian regime gets its hands on fuels more terror. We need to work with our allies to cut off every single dollar. 

That’s how we weaken the regime for good and ensure America’s security.

The people blaming Israel for situation in the Middle East need to stop talking about Israel and start focusing on the Iranian regime. 

They are the ones trying to kill Americans on American soil.
